description: MainActivity.java is the primary activity for an Android app providing a MIDI echo service. It sets up the user interface, manages MIDI device connections, and handles logging of MIDI messages.
external_methods: Logcat methods (e.g., Log.d, Log.i, not directly called here but implied for logging)

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity handling MIDI device interactions, user interface setup, and logging within the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI components, and configures MIDI input sources and logging.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters the scope logger.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and sets the initial 'keep screen on' setting.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions such as clearing logs and toggling 'keep screen on'.

methods.name: setKeepScreenOn
methods.description: Enables or disables the keep screen on flag for the activity window.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Schedules a log message to be appended to the UI.

methods.name: logOnUiThread
methods.description: Adds a log message to the internal buffer and updates the TextView display.
